title: 5 money stories you might've missed this week
summary_lines: The Fed is weighing another rate hike
Trump pauses Russia sanctions, sparking backlash
Retailers are using AI to change price tags on you

facts.n1_headline: The Fed is weighing another rate hike
facts.n1_line: The Fed is deciding whether to raise interest rates again.
facts.n2_headline: Trump pauses Russia sanctions, sparking backlash
facts.n2_line: Trump is taking up to 60 days to weigh the global impact of Russian sanctions.
facts.n3_headline: Retailers are using AI to change price tags on you
facts.n3_line: US retailers are using AI and personal data to set prices.
facts.n4_headline: IMF warns of rising risks to the global economy
facts.n4_line: The IMF warned that rising risks and an AI bubble could hurt the global economy.
facts.n5_headline: Meta and Tesla lead a big week of earnings reports
facts.n5_line: Meta and Tesla are reporting their latest earnings this week.
